description: Query describing the slice of timeline entries requested from an ITimelineDataProvider. Used by TmTimeline, TmActivityTimeline, and TmActivityLog to fetch filtered, incrementally paged audit data from a server.

members.name: SearchText
members.description: Optional free-text filter. Providers should match it case-insensitively against the author name, entry content, and entry type. Null/empty means no text filter.

members.name: EntryType
members.description: Optional entry-type filter (e.g. "comment", "status_change"). Null/empty means all types.

members.name: IncludeInternal
members.description: Whether internal entries should be included in the result.

members.name: Skip
members.description: Number of matching entries to skip before returning items.

members.name: Take
members.description: Maximum number of matching entries to return. int.MaxValue means return everything that matches (used when no page size is configured).
